subject.title: fix: control UI locale PRs fail to arm auto-merge

question: Should the Mantis GitHub App receive repository contents-write permission for generated-PR runs that request auto-merge?
rationale: This is an intentional GitHub App privilege expansion rather than a purely mechanical workflow correction, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Confirm and prove the narrow scope
options.body: Approve the conditional contents-write grant after verifying the installation permission and attach a successful locale-refresh run that arms auto-merge.

options.title: Use a separate narrowly scoped app
options.body: Keep the current Mantis token pull-request-only and route auto-merge through a distinct app or workflow credential with the minimum required repository permissions.

recommendation.title: Confirm and prove the narrow scope
recommendation.body: Approve the conditional contents-write grant after verifying the installation permission and attach a successful locale-refresh run that arms auto-merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies steipete as the contributor who traced the incident and implemented the proposed permission boundary.
